question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Tesla)

calls.reasoning: Q3 2026 is reported Oct 21. Known inputs: deliveries were 486,532 (vs 480,126 in Q2) and storage was 13.7 GWh (vs 13.5). Q2 revenue was $28.24B: auto $20.52B, energy $3.14B, services $4.58B. Scaling auto revenue per unit gives ~$20.8B, plus ~$3.2B energy and ~$4.7B services, for ~$28.7B. I shade the median down to $28.5B because production (464k) was below deliveries, which suggests an inventory drawdown, possibly with incentives or a cheaper mix that lowers ASP. Published consensus of $27.5-27.9B looks partly stale from before the delivery beat; consensus underestimated Q2 by ~$2.7B. Market check: Kalshi lists a Tesla Q3 deliveries KPI market (fetch was rate-limited), and I found no revenue market on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Resolves off Tesla's first reported quarterly revenue after Sept 2026, i.e. Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep) total revenues in the Oct 21, 2026 shareholder deck/8-K (call 5:30pm ET, per Tesla Oracle 2026-10-04 and MarketBeat). It does not resolve off delivery counts.
- Event window: Q3 2026 results release, scheduled 2026-10-21. As of 2026-10-11 the quarter is over and the report is still pending.
- Q3 2026 deliveries were 486,532 (Model 3/Y 478,237; other 8,295), down 2.1% YoY from 497,099 and up from Q2 2026's 480,126. Production was 464,391, below deliveries, which implies an inventory drawdown (Electrek 2026-10-02).
- Q3 2026 storage deployments were 13.7 GWh, vs 13.5 GWh in Q2 2026 and 12.5 GWh in Q3 2025. That missed the ~15.9 GWh consensus (Electrek; TradersAgency 2026-10-02).
- Tesla IR's company-compiled delivery consensus was 461,974 (range 421,758-482,000) (TeslaNorth 2026-09-29).
- Q2 2026 total revenue was $28.24B (+26% YoY): automotive $20.52B, energy $3.14B, services & other $4.58B (a record, +50% YoY). Regulatory credit revenue 'nearly vanished'. The Q2 consensus was ~$25.55B, so the actual beat it by ~$2.7B (EvWire; Teslarati, July 2026).
- Q3 2025 revenue was $28.10B (MarketBeat comparison).
- Revenue consensus figures quoted for Q3 2026, of unclear timing and possibly from before the delivery release: MarketBeat $27.92B, S&P Global $27.73B, another aggregator $27.49B.
- Analyst commentary (TradingKey 2026-10-05): it is unclear whether the delivery beat came with deeper incentives, inventory drawdown and lower ASPs.
- Q2 auto revenue per delivered vehicle: ~$42.7k (20.52B/480k).
- Searched but not found: post-delivery consensus revisions, Q3 ASP or pricing data, a Q2 one-off breakdown, any revenue prediction market (only a Kalshi Tesla deliveries KPI market exists; Polymarket and Manifold had no revenue market).

calls.reasoning: Q3 2026 deliveries 486.5k (+1.3% QoQ) and storage 13.7 GWh (+1.5%) against Q2's $28.24B revenue. Bottom-up: auto ~$20.65B (ASP ~$41.5k, slight trim for mix/incentives and S/X wind-down, minimal credits), energy ~$3.2B, services ~$4.6B, so ~$28.45B. Published consensus of $27.5-28.3B pulls down slightly, but it is partly pre-delivery-beat and Q2 beat consensus heavily. Main risks: Q2 services jump was non-recurring (downside) or energy pricing differs. No revenue prediction market found (Kalshi has deliveries markets only; none on Polymarket/Manifold).
calls.reconciliation: Runs agreed on all key facts (Q3 deliveries 486,532, storage 13.7 GWh, Q2 revenue $28.24B with segment split, report Oct 21). The size of Q2's consensus beat ($1.8B vs $2.7B) depends on which Q2 consensus figure is right; I could not settle that without web access, and it does not change the direction. The Q3 consensus spread ($27.5-28.3B) is also unsettled and may be stale. Judgment calls: services persistence (assumed mostly persistent) and auto ASP (trimmed ~2% vs Q2 for mix/incentives). Production < deliveries implies an inventory drawdown, which by itself does not reduce recognized revenue. Bottom-up gives ~$28.45B, a touch below the runs' delivery scaling to reflect the consensus pull and ASP risk.
